data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (search, type venue, select venue, open booking, pick date, select time) and names venue, date and time as parameters, but it leaves out party_size and the optional experience choice and describes the booking/search dialog step vaguely, so an automation built from it would have gaps.
